rationale: C04 is a near-direct antecedent: it authorizes Federal Trade Commission inspection of corporation income-tax returns for the same statutory purpose, uses the same Treasury-regulation mechanism, and follows the same operative sequence and effectiveness clause. The child principally updates the covered returns to those made under the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 and changes the referenced Treasury decision and responsible Treasury official. C22 contains essentially the same FTC-specific template but is older; C10 closely parallels the administrative structure while applying it to a different agency and tax-return records.

shared_material.child_excerpt: income tax returns of corporations made under the Internal Revenue Code of 1954 shall be open to inspection by the Federal Trade Commission as an aid in executing the powers conferred on such Commission by the Federal Trade Commission Act of September 26, 1914 (38 Stat. 717)
shared_material.parent_excerpt: corporation income tax returns made for the year 1953 and subsequent years shall be open to inspection by the Federal Trade Commission as an aid in executing the powers conferred upon such Commission by the Federal Trade Commission Act of September 26, 1914, 38 Stat. 717
shared_material.explanation: The recipient agency, records, statutory purpose, and much of the wording are virtually identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such inspection shall be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Acting Secretary of the Treasury in the Treasury decision approved by me this date, relating to the inspection of such returns by the Federal Trade Commission.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: such inspection to be in accordance and upon compliance with the rules and regulations prescribed by the Secretary of the Treasury in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of returns by the Federal Trade Commission, approved by me this date.
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same Treasury-decision machinery, with only minor syntactic changes and the substitution of the Acting Secretary.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This Executive order shall become effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the FEDERAL REGISTER.
shared_material.explanation: The effectiveness clause is nearly verbatim and completes the same sequence of provisions.
